ui.common.backend_startup.detail_startin: Starting can take up to {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
ui.common.backend_startup.title_failed: The Local Operator server could not start.
ui.common.backend_startup.title_stopped: The Local Operator server stopped unexpectedly.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.port_in: Another program is using the port the server needs. Close that program or restart your computer, then restart the server.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.port_fo: Windows has reserved the port the server needs. Restarting your computer usually releases it; then restart the server.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.executa: Your security software blocked the server from running. Allow Local Operator in your antivirus settings, then restart the server.
Part of the server installation is missing, possibly removed by security software. Reinstall Local Operator, then restart the server.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.crashed: The server hit an error while starting. Restart the server; if it fails again, copy the diagnostics to share when you ask for help.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.exited: The server stopped before it finished starting. Restart the server; if it stops again, copy the diagnostics to share when you ask for help.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.timed_o: The server did not answer within {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}. Your computer may be busy; restart the server to try again.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.unknown: Something stopped the server from starting. Restart the server; if it happens again, copy the diagnostics to share when you ask for help.
ui.common.backend_startup.reason.stopped: It was running and then stopped. Restart the server to continue; if it keeps stopping, copy the diagnostics to share when you ask for help.
ui.common.backend_startup.repeated_failu: Still not starting after {count, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}}. Copy the diagnostics to share when you ask for help.
